column3: Close to the Hebrew; NKJV supplies “To,” “To take away our reproach.”
NKJV capitalizes “the Branch of the LORD,” reading it messianically; “for beauty and glory” is rendered “beautiful and glorious.”
Close to the Hebrew; “excrement” is rendered “the filth.”
Close to the Hebrew; “every place” is rendered “every dwelling place,” and “a canopy” “a covering.”
